symptom: Regression from #2546: check and exec refused `treenode … (advancedMode: true)` on a web page with MDL-WIDGET10 (error, CE0463 claimed), though the page builds with 0 errors and renders (ako/mxcli#2549).
cause: The evaluator ran getProperties with target "desktop" only. TreeNode's bundle hides advancedMode unless target is "web" (and for "web" hides animate/icons while advancedMode is off). The "desktop" choice was an assumption from the pluggable-widgets typings, never measured against mxbuild.
fix: Run getProperties for both "web" and "desktop" and count a property hidden only when both hide it.
insight: Measured on 11.16.1, TreeNode 3.4.0, TestApp: advancedMode true (hidden for desktop) and animate false with advancedMode off (hidden for web) both pass mx check with 0 errors, and mx update-widgets resets neither — mxbuild enforces neither target-dependent branch — while a target-independent hide (Image iconSize outside icon mode) is CE0463. Two pages, each hidden under exactly one target, settle which target a tool uses in one mx check; the #2546 trial compared against static rules, which shared the same unmeasured premise, so it could not catch it.
test: modelsdk/widgets/editorconfig/editorconfig_test.go TestHiddenRequiresBothTargets; live: both TreeNode pages pass check, the Image iconSize control is still refused
